verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-hosted inference server with an OpenAI-compatible API, so credential scoping is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents issuing API credentials, scoped or least-privilege, for agents or anyone else. The cited material covers inference performance, the API surface, OpenAPI docs and the deprecation policy, none of which addresses credential issuance or access scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
